testcase.name: an unknown exception is permanent but its type and message are kept, not replaced by a generic text()
retry policy retries only transient failures, up to the limit, with growing backoff()
a step that exceeds its deadline is cut off, and the step's own exceptions come through unwrapped()
a timeout while building is transient but a timeout while deploying is ambiguous and never retried()
addresses and credentials are removed from what is stored and shown()
a permanent build failure keeps its message and is not retried()
a render worker that is down or answers 5xx is transient, a 401 is not()
an IO error is transient and says which step it hit()
the code can be read back from a stored error, old unprefixed errors have none()
the stored reason always fits the 1000 character column and carries the attempt count()
